INFERENCE: the tradeable discrepancy is not 'Australia is hawkish' as a fresh macro call — bonds already show that — it is that housing-consensus receivers and crowded AUD longs own the fade of further RBA tightening, leaving Mar-27 AONIA as the cleaner squeeze if global tightening (Fed delivered, BoJ 1.25%, energy still a constraint) forces a higher Australian terminal. UNKNOWN: side of AONIA October open interest, MX CORRA specs, CME SR3 specs, and any post-2026-09-15 CFTC change. This seat therefore pays AONIA_2027-03 and closes the crowded CORRA receive rather than adding to CA-US value.
trade.mispricing: FACT: Mar-27 AONIA implied 4.86 versus cash 4.35 (+51bp) and versus AU 2Y 4.999. INFERENCE: the back of the AONIA curve still treats housing as a hard cap after two hikes, while inflation, global policy, and AUD ownership argue that cap is the consensus, not an edge. The October contract is the wrong place to pay (21.5bp of a 25bp hike already in, and that is where OI lives). UNKNOWN: whether RBA's next meeting calendar maps a full 25bp into the March window versus a later contract; packet gives implied rates not a meeting-probability model.
trade.horizon: 1-4 months, through the next RBA path into 2027 H1 AONIA
trade.invalidation: AONIA strip losing the second hike (Mar-27 implied rate falling back toward unchanged-from-overnight) on housing/activity confirmation that the RBA is capped, or AUD CFTC open interest leaving the extreme while the AONIA back-end still refuses to reprice higher. Wrong-entry versus wrong-thesis: a noisy thin Mar-27 print without a lower path is not by itself thesis failure.

Rates and spot are comparably directional on AUD, so the rates-first rule selects AONIA.

A 99th-percentile 2Y is a discovery signal, not a fade. Keep paying SOFR_2027-03; do not open a duplicate.

trade.structure: outright pay/short CME SR3 March 2027 (SOFR_2027-03 / SR3H7) in implied-rate space; profits if the canonical implied-rate mark rises
trade.thesis: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; official SOFR is 3.85; SR3H7 / SOFR_2027-03 implied is 4.58, +73bp versus overnight; the strip still peaks at 4.755 in Sep-27; US 2Y 4.76 is +57bp 1m and +9bp 1d; US gauges remain 69-75; BoJ hiked to 1.25% and the desk thesis says the energy shock is constraining global easing. INFERENCE: price, the rate strip, and macro revisions are still aligned with a hiking trend; 99th-percentile yields are what a continuing trend looks like, not a reversal. The clean continuation is to stay short duration in SOFR_2027-03 rather than fade it or migrate to spot. UNKNOWN: live CME positioning, post-18 Sep SR3 ticks, and whether the next CPI/labor print breaks the hot-gauge regime. Book action is HOLD of pos-662bff0986be at 50m; do not OPEN a second SOFR_2027-03.
trade.mispricing: The market is treating a delivered, >90%-priced 25bp hike plus 99th-percentile 1y yields as terminal for 2027H1 SOFR. That underweights the still-hot US gauges, the still-positively-sloped SR3 strip into Sep-27, and the 1d continuation in sovereigns. Fading Mar-27 at 4.58 because later contracts already print 4.72-4.755 is the premature fade: continuation means H7 can still cheapen toward that later peak, and the peak itself can still rise if another hike is delivered.
trade.horizon: 1-4 months, through the next two US CPI/labor prints and the remaining 2026 FOMC meetings into 2027H1
trade.invalidation: A US inflation or labor break that turns both the SR3 strip and the US 2Y 1d/1m uptrend lower. Housing-pain headlines, 99th-percentile yield levels, or an unchanged 4.58 mark after one session do not count as reversal.
